sentences.span: Dealer / Market-Maker -books which had become suddenly short (Customer -bot) Puts and OTM Puts ... Thursday ended up as the biggest put day in CBOE history. Dealers who sold all those puts hedged by shorting futures ... Dealers had to buy back a BRICK of Short $Delta / Futures
sentences.why: Nomura's McElligott note (relayed via Zero Hedge) describes dealers becoming short puts after Thursday's record put-buying day, hedging by shorting futures, then being forced to buy those futures back as vol collapsed and prices rose — matching the sentence's causal chain exactly.

sentences.span: 424 S&P 500 members closed higher against just 79 decliners ... Even the Dow, the S&P and the Russell erased their post-election losses... The VIX went from 28 to 20 in roughly two and a half sessions
sentences.why: All three figures (VIX 28->20 in ~2.5 sessions, 424 of 503 S&P members higher, Dow/S&P/Russell erasing post-election losses) are stated directly in this source.

sentences.span: October CPI printed 0.4% MoM vs 0.3% expected, and core rose 0.3% vs 0.2% expected, a print that only 1 of 70 analysts saw coming ... as the Vol meltdown has stalled-out, so too has the Stock rally
sentences.why: CPI print figures, the 1-of-70 forecast detail, and the vol-meltdown-stopping-the-rally framing are all directly supported.

sentences.span: Is The AI Puke Finally Over? JPMorgan Says Capitulation Is Fa[st approaching]

sentences.span: the washout has started, but history says it rarely finishes in one day ... Since 1996, Krinsky counts 15 prior occasions ... a coin-toss
